This status is based on the supplied project documentation and example XLSForms. It is not a formal validation claim.
:::


## Purpose

Scan QR codes and supported barcode formats. The exact decoded payload is the primary result; HTTP(S) payloads also receive an explicit link field.

## Capability IDs

- `barcode.scan` — canonical
- `qr.scan` — deprecated compatibility contract

## Requirements

- Camera permission.

## Supported XLSForm calls


**From `example_odk_barcode.scan.xlsx`:**

```text
com.example.methodmesh.EXECUTE_METHOD(method_id='barcode.scan')
```


The legacy `example_odk_qr.scan.xlsx` continues to call `qr.scan` during the compatibility window.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Description |
|---|---:|---|
| `input_barcode_formats` | No | Pipe-delimited ZXing format identifiers. Omit for automatic detection. |


## Expected returned fields

`barcode_payload` is the exact decoded string. `barcode_payload_kind` is `text` or `url`; `barcode_payload_url` is present only for a safe absolute HTTP(S) URL. `barcode_format` records the detected symbology and `barcode_payload_sha256` provides an integrity digest.

The payload is never trimmed or converted to a number, so identifiers and retail codes retain leading zeros. URL presentation is clickable inside MethodMesh, but opening the link always requires a user action.
